display_long_description:
**Step into the race in VR**
*Speedway Race Clash* is a fast-paced arcade racing experience built for Meta Quest. Jump into the driver’s seat and compete across multiple tracks with AI opponents in quick, intense races designed for VR.

**Race Across 9 Unique Tracks**
From tight technical layouts to high-speed circuits, each track challenges your control, reflexes, and racing strategy.

**Drive Multiple Car Classes**
Start with Classic cars and unlock faster machines as you progress:
• Classic Cars — balanced and accessible
• GT Cars — faster and more demanding
• F1 Cars — maximum speed and precision

**Earn, Unlock, Progress**
Win races, earn coins, and unlock new cars and tracks. Improve your performance, master each class, and climb to the fastest tier.

**Built for VR Gameplay**
• Short races (20–30 seconds) — perfect for quick sessions
• Smooth controls and responsive driving
• 7 AI opponents per race
• Easy to start, challenging to master

**From First Lap to Full Speed**
Whether you’re aiming for perfect lines or just enjoying the speed, every race pushes you closer to faster cars and tougher challenges.

Are you ready to take the lead?......
